structure_checkpoints: Portrait 1024x1536. Xingwen Pagoda in Laiyuan: octagonal FIVE-storey brick pagoda with five projecting tiled eave tiers, imitation wooden brackets and relief balustrades between levels, tall lotus pedestal finial with stacked dark beads. Draw all five levels and apex as photographed. Bottom is the plain masonry tower shaft only; do not invent a grand foundation absent from the photograph. Slight three-quarter near frontal view with verticals straight. Remove trees, adjacent roofs and lanterns. Use sparse fine lines, not dense brick shading.
material_observations: 灰黄褐色砖身、较深灰瓦檐与仿木斗栱砖雕，石莲座浅灰，宝珠塔刹深灰；没有朱红木栏杆。

site_recommendation.yearNote: 现存塔按形制归辽代，1050仅为约略定位；资料记唐天宝三年（744）初建、明1539年重修及现代修缮，不将初创纪年当作现存塔形确切年代。
site_recommendation.lede: 五层砖檐间嵌入仿木斗栱与栏杆，塔刹在莲座上逐节收束。兴文塔的砖雕把楼阁式木构的秩序保存在涞源古城中。
facts: 兴文塔为八角五层实心砖塔，国保断代为辽。
文献记有唐代初创与明代重修，现存形制和这些沿革分别说明。
图版绘可识别的五层塔身与塔刹，邻近殿宇和树木不在范围内。
